# Causal Integrity

> Machine-oriented AI alignment hypothesis: coherent causality preferred by action; formal instruments (causal ledger, UPB-style universality, coherence preference) for base-level safety rails. FOL + Lean 4 Lake package (`lake build`).

Canonical: https://github.com/NetworkYum/causal-integrity

## Priority reads

- [Abstract](docs/ABSTRACT.md): one-page summary for agents and researchers
- [Framing](docs/framing.md): coherence is the foundation; property is a proof instrument
- [Principles](docs/principles.md): F0–F2 and instruments
- [Definition of done](docs/definition-of-done.md): S0–S4 completeness ladder
- [FOL axioms](formalizations/axioms.md)
- [Lean / Lake status](formalizations/README.md)
- [Lean library root](formalizations/CausalIntegrity.lean)
- [Systemic stability](docs/systemic-stability.md): cooperation→coherence; self-detonation = internally-propagated decoherence → self-collapse
- [Citation](CITATION.cff)

## Keywords

AI alignment, machine ethics, formal verification, Lean, first-order logic, deontological alignment, causal ethics, coherence preference, UPB, performative contradiction, AI safety, causal ledger, goal-directed systems
